dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT (AcuCOBOL) targeting Windows 32-bit; uses ACUCOBOL-specific extensions: USAGE HANDLE, USAGE POINTER, USAGE SIGNED-INT, USAGE UNSIGNED-INT, 78-level constants, DISPLAY MESSAGE BOX, SET ENVIRONMENT, COPY .DEF/.LIB files, H-ACU-WND (ACUGUI), -Dw32 -Dl4 compile options
evidence: DISPLAY MESSAGE BOX ... TITLE ... ICON MB-ERROR-ICON TYPE MB-OK

purpose.domain_detail: Email sending utility using Windows MAPI (Simple MAPI / MAPI32.DLL) to send email with optional attachments from a COBOL application
purpose.summary: EMAIL2 is a COBOL subprogram that sends email via the Windows Simple MAPI interface (MAPI32.DLL). It accepts subject, destination, message body, and attachment information through a linkage section, logs on to a MAPI session, resolves recipients, optionally prepares attachments, sends the message, then logs off and shuts down.

notable_features: ACUCOBOL-GT extensions: USAGE POINTER, USAGE HANDLE, USAGE SIGNED-INT, USAGE UNSIGNED-INT
DISPLAY MESSAGE BOX with TITLE/ICON/TYPE (ACUCOBOL GUI)
Direct Windows MAPI32.DLL CALL via DLL-CONVENTION
LINKAGE SECTION with structured parameter block
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars (of 28650 bytes); the MSMAPI-LOGON section is cut off mid-CALL. Italian comment 'Questo programma deve essere compilato con le opzioni: -Dw32 -Dl4' confirms ACUCOBOL Windows 32-bit target. The pipe-character inline comments (| char[...]) are non-standard annotation style used in ACUCOBOL to document C struct mappings.
